cr_data.provenance: Estate of the artist, 1986; Private collection, 1987 (Source: Georgia O'Keeffe Museum)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. O'Keeffe took a leave of absence from her teaching position in February 1918 and moved to San Antonio, Texas. Completed in San Antonio, on basis of Stieglitz–O'Keeffe correspondence. See cat. nos. 229–40, 243–50. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles:
Tree with Green Shade
An Expanding Collection, 1998, Georgia O'Keeffe Museum (Santa Fe)

description: Small vertical watercolor with green slatted window shade in the lower left corner.  From the lower right growing up through the page reaching to the middle of the top is a large brown tree trunk with various small branches and foliage sprouting off.  Along the top is a red line, and along the right side are a red and a  blue line.
